name: CSS Peeper
summary: Designer-oriented panel that lists a page's colors, typography and downloadable assets and shows the CSS values behind the element under the cursor, with premium features behind in-app purchases.
browsersNote: Edge listing carries the same tagline; author not independently confirmed; no Firefox listing found.
license: Proprietary; store page links Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy (csspeeper.com).
goodFor: Reading a page's colors, type and assets with their CSS values in one panel.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: css inspector style extractor colors typography assets designer
